login2faRequiredDesc: Enter a six-digit authenticator code or an unused login backup code.
login2faBackupHint: Cannot access authenticator? Use backup codes instead.
loginToastFailedDesc: Please check your input and try again.
errorInvalidRequest: The login request is invalid. Refresh the page and try again.
errorTooFrequent: Too many requests. Please try again later.
errorServiceUnavailable: The authentication service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
loginAccountLockedDesc: Your account has been locked. Please try again later or contact administrator.
passwordLengthHint: At least 9 characters, up to 72 bytes.
errorLoginTemporarilyLocked: Too many failed sign-in attempts. Sign-in is temporarily locked; try again later
errorAlreadyInitialized: This instance is already initialized. Sign in instead
errorInvalidOrigin: The request origin is not trusted. Open the instance at its own address
